Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in a traffic lane in Pearland, Texas, when the rear of the vehicle was struck by Driver 2. The
damgae to Driver 1's vehicle is largely in line with an impact of this kind, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is
known to the responding officer. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat and reported pain in the right
shoulder. Officers and two independent witnesses confirmed that Passenger was inside the vehcile at the time. The
shoulder complaint fits the forward and rearward motion described at the scene. Witnesses, scene photographs and
Driver 2's own account all agree on how the collision happened. Driver 1 is listed on the policy as a person who may
not operate the vehicle, a piont noted for the insurer's review. No citations were issued at the scene while the
investigation continues.
